style: Say with lively energy, like a friendly game show host
lines: Good morning, crew! One story, four ways. Tap the fact chips to build each version.
Hold on. That fact doesn't match the others.
All four say the same thing. Now plan your week.
Three hours a day. Tap a job to spend them, then press Run day.
That's the day. Check who heard it.
It's three fifteen on Friday. Here's who got the message.
A whole group never heard about it. Which group, and why?
Compare the group bars. Tap Try the week again to change your distribution.
Choose a fact from the menu, then tap the version to put it on your canvas.
Tap a slot below the monitor, then tap a shot to put it there.
Tap a picture from the shot bin to put it on this version.
Tap a headline to put it on this version. All three fit the story.
Tap sentence chips in order to build your announcement. Tap Hear it to listen.
That job needs more hours than the crew has today. Cancel a job or choose another day.
That day has already run. Tap Undo day to change the last day.
Tap a cell to buy or cancel its job. Use the desk for copies and translations.
The video edit continues tomorrow. It can air when all four editing hours are done.
Tap Yes, reset to clear your work, or Keep our work to return.
That fact doesn't match the story brief. Tap the other variant to change it.
That sentence doesn't match the story brief. Tap Undo sentence to remove it, then choose the right facts.
